consequence.statement: Traefik will not start if the static configuration still contains the Rancher provider configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove all Rancher provider configuration from the static configuration; Rancher 2.x users should use the Kubernetes CRD provider directly.

assertion.statement: The Rancher v1 provider (providers.rancher) was removed in Traefik v3; leaving its configuration in place prevents Traefik from starting, and Rancher 2.x users should use the Kubernetes CRD provider.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for config-key removed
